note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the contract, its order-of-documents clause and the annexes are generic placeholders. Scenarios A and B are identical except for ONE supplied fact: the listed position of the changed annex (A: listed first; B: configured lower). The order shown is only the supplied order list — no interpretation doctrine, no conflict rule, no document prevails beyond its supplied position, no winner, no outcome, no jurisdiction. A and B have equal visual weight (same stage art; badges in their lane colours). Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): definitions; the clause text (only the clause heading is drawn, in the shared strip); clauses = the supplied order-of-documents clause heading, schedules = the annexes, priorities = the shared order of the other annexes, changedAnnex + scenarioA/B.position = the changed fact.
